summary: Anchor checks confused failed UTF-8 decoding with input boundaries, allowing ^ and $ to match at incorrect positions in byte haystacks. The fix checks byte offsets directly while preserving newline handling. Reverse the ByteInput correction and select the fix-added bytes::invalidutf8_anchor1 test, generated by matiter! in tests/bytes.rs and included by the nfa-bytes integration target. It expects only (0, 0); the reversal permits additional matches after invalid bytes. Both source regions occur exactly once. No tests were executed.
